page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred. Large title block at top; a woodcut vignette with a banner in the middle; imprint lines below; a small library stamp at the bottom (not transcribed). Faint show-through of another page's text is visible behind the title and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: NON ÆSTAS EST LÆTA DIU, COMPONITE NIDOS.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a farmyard scene with two figures at a barn door, a man with a pitchfork, a horse and cart, a church spire in the distance, and a banner bearing the motto above. The banner text is set in small capitals and is transcribed as printed. A blue ink cross mark at lower right and a Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München stamp are not transcribed. The title lines "SS. THEOLOGIAE PROFESSORIS" and "TOMUS QUINTUS." are kept as printed. The engraving is described here only.
